method: facts -> rule by direct pattern match of the listed facts (SSS three sides; SAS two sides + included angle; ASA two angles + included side; AAS two angles + non-included side; RHS right angle + hypotenuse + one leg); "None of these" correct iff the facts leave more than one non-congruent triangle (explicit SSA root count by the law of cosines / angles-only); rules are applied to the listed facts only (a third angle derived by angle sum is not used)
assumptions: ASA and AAS are interchangeable once the third angle is derived (angle sum); the rule is the one whose premise is literally listed. SSA with the opposite side not shorter than the adjacent side determines a unique triangle but is not a congruence rule in the syllabus: such an item would have no correct option and is flagged.
